questions.stem: Among the following options, a Drug not to be used with tadalafil is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Isosorbide dinitrate
  • Tadalafil is a Phosphodiesterase 5 (PDE5) inhibitor .
  • combination of Phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitors like Sildenafil, vardenafil, and tadalafil with organic nitrate vasodilators(e.g.Isosorbide dinitrate) can cause extreme hypotension.
  • Nitrate+PDE 5 inhibitors→ Increased cGMP→ Vasodilation→Hypotension (most common), Increased Heart rate,Myocardial Infarction(rare). 


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:328

questions.stem: Visual disturbances seen with vardenafil are due to the inhibition of:
questions.solutionHtml:
PDE 6
  • Sildenafil and vardenafil weakly inhibit the PDE6 enzyme.
  • PDE6 enzyme is involved in photoreceptor signal transduction

questions.stem: A 45-year-old man came to OPD with a complaint that the drug he was taking caused an abnormal increase in the size of his breasts. The medical history of the patient was negative for past diseases or the use of alcohol or drugs. Two weeks earlier, the man was diagnosed with bilateral adrenal hyperplasia and had started an appropriate treatment. Which of the following drugs most likely caused the adverse effect in this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Spironolactone
  • The patient’s bilateral adrenal hyperplasia most likely caused primary hyperaldosteronism, a disorder that is usually controlled by spironolactone.
  • Spironolactone is a competitive aldosterone receptor antagonist, but it can bind to other steroid receptors.
  • The blockade of androgen receptors is most likely the primary mechanism of spironolactone-induced gynecomastia.
  • Gynecomastia is a well-known adverse effect of this drug; the overall prevalence is about 10%.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 634-637

questions.stem: A 53-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital because of severe thoracic pain after a fall at home. Medical history was significant for mastectomy for breast cancer 8 years ago. An x-ray showed a fracture of three ribs and advanced osteoporosis. An appropriate therapy was started that included a drug that could lead to an increase in the bone mass index and could also decrease the risk of breast cancer reactivation. Which of the following drugs was most likely administered?
questions.solutionHtml:
Raloxifene
  • Raloxifene is a selective estrogen receptor modulator.
  • Such drugs can have estrogenic effects in bone but estrogen antagonist action on breast and uterine receptors.
  • Raloxifene is approved both for the treatment of postmenopausal osteoporosis and for breast cancer risk reduction and therefore can be appropriate therapy in a subset of women with postmenopausal osteoporosis who are at risk of breast cancer, as in this case.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:338-339
